pages.title: Betterwines Home

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Geir Sviland
Managing Director / Owner
Tel: +47 908 23 095
Independent Wine Importer in Norway
We are not looking for the biggest wineries. We are looking for the right ones.
Our story began in 1996, when Geir Sviland and Jan Stubne founded Best Buys International. In 2007, Better Wines was established, building on a passion for fine wines, personal relationships and a deep understanding of the Norwegian wine market.
Today, we are an independent, owner-managed wine importer with strong relationships among Norway's leading restaurants, sommeliers and wine professionals.
Small Enough to Care. Experienced Enough to Deliver.
We have a special passion for independent, family-owned wineries and smaller estates where quality, craftsmanship and authenticity come first.
Why Work with Better Wines?
30 Years of Experience – Deep knowledge of the Norwegian wine market and established relationships with leading restaurants.
Financial Strength & Reliability – A financially strong, profitable company committed to long-term partnerships.
Personal Commitment – We know our producers, believe in their wines and work to build their reputation in Norway.
Your wines are your life's work. We take that responsibility seriously.
Better Wines – Let's Build Success Together.
